column2: Speed: your voice keeps going to Gemini instantly while the first second is matched in parallel — no delay in your reply. If it is someone else's voice, DK will neither speak a reply nor do anything on the phone.

column2: A Light theme is not available yet: most screens use white text, which would be unreadable on a light background. "Follow system" is not offered for the same reason — the app always stays dark.
